table_metadata: This table evaluates supplier performance based on procurement transactions for hotel inventory items. Each record represents a supplier providing a specific SKU. The table captures transaction counts, total quantity supplied, procurement spend, average unit price, and a computed supplier performance score. Items follow a hierarchy where CATEGORY represents the top-level grouping (e.g., Food or Beverage), ITEM_GROUP represents the subcategory, and SKU_NAME represents the specific product supplied.

ITEM_NAME.description: Specific inventory product supplied by suppliers

SUPPLIER.description: Name of the supplier or suppliers providing the inventory item. There can be multiple suppliers for a single SKU.

ANNUAL_PURCHASE_FREQUENCY.description: Number of procurement transactions completed with the supplier for the given SKU

TOTAL_QTY_SUPPLIED.description: Total quantity of the SKU supplied by the supplier across transactions

TOTAL_MONEY_SPEND.description: Total procurement spend for the SKU from the supplier

AVG_UNIT_PRICE.description: Average price per unit calculated from procurement transactions

SUPPLIER_SCORE.description: Composite supplier performance score derived from price competitiveness, reliability, and transaction history

SUPPLIER_RANK.description: Rank assigned to the supplier for the SKU based on the final supplier score

CATEGORY.description: Top-level inventory category used for procurement classification

ITEM_GROUP.description: Subcategory of the item within the broader category (e.g., POULTRY, LAMB AND GOAT MEAT, SODAS, MINERAL WATER)
